summary: Example task retrieves VyOS version info with vyos_command show version.
questions: How do I get the VyOS version with Ansible?

answer_card.title: Get VyOS version
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- name: Retrieve VyOS version info
  vyos.vyos.vyos_command:
    commands: show version
  when: ansible_network_os == 'vyos.vyos.vyos'
```
